$comment: The source of sf-checkbox's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/checkbox (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

x-summary: A native checkbox with a label, Framework presentation and checked, indeterminate and disabled states kept in step between the host attributes and the inner input.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-checkbox when the interface needs the checkbox behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

x-decisions: a11y-role: checkbox, the native input's own role; the name comes from the label, the label slot, then the host's aria-label (§4.8).
key-effects: Space is toggle:checked (the native checkbox), Tab reach; probe.json drives Space (gate 16).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (the checked reference) plus off, indeterminate, description and help, end position, invalid, disabled and size 2.

css-variables: the six public variables of src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json plus one per recolourable state, checked and invalid (§6); the state rules read them with the role token as fallback.

set-boolean-state-attribute is not an action: it is the element's own helper for checked/indeterminate/disabled attributes, never a request a rule makes; the method stays, the interface drops it (§4.4).
checked is not optional: the checkbox has no inherited state, so absent and false are one state and checked="false" is never written.
help is an icon name (the template draws <sf-icon icon>), as sf-switch declares it.
error -> invalid: §17.2 makes invalid the shown state and error its dated alias (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01); the class .error stays the look.
value defaults to "on": a checked box without value submits "on", as a native checkbox (§17.1 item 2; it submitted "" before).
form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals; the inner checkbox carries no name (§17.1 item 6); validity is custom-error only.
version 1.1.0: a renamed member behind a dated alias is a minor (§4.10, §16.20).
